q1_dullDissatisfaction.prompt: What is the dull, persistent dissatisfaction you've learned to live with?
q1_dullDissatisfaction.help: Not deep suffering — the thing you've quietly tolerated. If you don't hate it, you'll keep tolerating it.

q2_repeatedComplaints.prompt: What do you complain about repeatedly but never actually change?
q2_repeatedComplaints.help: Write the three complaints you've voiced most often this past year.

q3_behaviorVsWords.prompt: For each complaint — what would someone watching your behavior conclude you actually want?
q3_behaviorVsWords.help: Behavior reveals goals more honestly than words.

q4_unbearableTruth.prompt: What truth about your current life would be unbearable to admit to someone you deeply respect?
q4_unbearableTruth.help: Write it anyway. The naming is the loosening.

q5_fiveYearTuesday.prompt: If absolutely nothing changes for 5 years — describe an average Tuesday.
q5_fiveYearTuesday.help: Where do you wake up? What does your body feel like? What do you do between 9 and 6? How do you feel at 10pm?

q6_tenYearMissed.prompt: Now do it for 10 years out — what have you missed? Which opportunities closed? Who gave up on you?
q6_tenYearMissed.help: What do people say about you when you're not in the room?

q7_endOfLife.prompt: End-of-life perspective — you lived the safe version. What was the cost?
q7_endOfLife.help: What did you never let yourself feel, try, or become?

q8_alreadyLivingFuture.prompt: Who in your life is already living the future you just described?
q8_alreadyLivingFuture.help: Someone 5, 10, 20 years ahead on the same trajectory. What do you feel when you imagine becoming them?

q9_identityToGiveUp.prompt: What identity would you have to give up to actually change?
q9_identityToGiveUp.help: Complete: 'I am the type of person who…' — and notice what would cost you socially to no longer be that.

q10_embarrassingReason.prompt: What's the most embarrassing reason you haven't changed?
q10_embarrassingReason.help: The one that makes you sound weak, scared, or lazy — not reasonable.

q11_protectionCost.prompt: If your current behavior is self-protection — what exactly are you protecting? What is that costing you?
q11_protectionCost.help: Both questions need an honest answer.

q12_idealTuesday.prompt: Snap your fingers — you live your ideal life in 3 years. Describe an average Tuesday.
q12_idealTuesday.help: Same level of detail as Q5. Forget practicality.

q13_identityToHave.prompt: What would you have to believe about yourself for that life to feel natural rather than forced?
q13_identityToHave.help: Write the identity statement: 'I am the type of person who…'

q14_oneActionThisWeek.prompt: Name one thing you would do this week if you were already that person.

e1_whyStuck.prompt: After today — what feels most true about why you've been stuck?

e2_actualEnemy.prompt: Name the actual enemy. Not circumstances, not people — the internal pattern or belief that has been running the show.

e3_antiVisionSentence.prompt: Write a single sentence: what you refuse to let your life become.
e3_antiVisionSentence.help: This is your anti-vision compressed. It should make you feel something when you read it.

e4_visionSentence.prompt: Write a single sentence: what you're building toward — knowing it will evolve.
e4_visionSentence.help: This is your vision MVP. Brevity is fine; depth comes from the months of action that follow.

e5_oneYearLens.prompt: One-year lens: what single thing has to be true in 12 months for the old pattern to be broken?
e5_oneYearLens.help: Concrete, observable, binary. Not 'feel better' — 'launched X' / 'lost Y' / 'shipped Z'.

e6_oneMonthLens.prompt: One-month project: what does this month's boss fight look like?
e6_oneMonthLens.help: What do you need to learn / build / acquire so the one-year lens stays possible?

e7_dailyLevers.prompt: Two or three daily levers: actions the future-you would simply do, no negotiation.
e7_dailyLevers.help: Block them in your calendar tomorrow.

e8_constraints.prompt: Constraints: what are you NOT willing to sacrifice to get there?
e8_constraints.help: These are the rules of your game. Without rules, there's no game.

i2_filmedBehavior.prompt: If someone filmed the last two hours, what would they conclude I want from my life?

i3_lifeIHate.short: Toward life I want or hate?

i4_pretendingNotImportant.prompt: What's the most important thing I'm pretending isn't important?

i5_identityProtection.prompt: What did I do today out of identity protection rather than genuine desire?

i6_aliveVsDead.prompt: When did I feel most alive today? When did I feel most dead?

i7_stoppedNeeding.prompt: What would change if I stopped needing people to see me a certain way?

i8_aliveVsSafety.prompt: Where in my life am I trading aliveness for safety?

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1: We collect information you provide directly to us when you create an account, including your name, email address, and any content you add to your vision board, goals, and gratitude journal. We also collect usage data such as the features you use and how often you check in, to help us improve the product experience.
s2Items: Send you product updates if you opt in
privacy.s2Outro: We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.s3: Your data is securely stored using Google Firebase (Firestore), hosted in the United States. Firebase employs industry-standard encryption at rest and in transit. Vision board images are stored as compressed base64 data within your Firestore documents and are never shared with other users.
privacy.s4: We use Firebase Authentication to manage sign-in. You may sign in with email/password or Google OAuth. We never store your raw passwords — all credentials are managed by Firebase's secure authentication system.
privacy.s5: We use browser localStorage to remember your theme preference, language, and session state. We do not use tracking cookies or third-party advertising networks.
privacy.s6: You may request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time by contacting us. We will process the request within 30 days.
privacy.s7: We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or an in-app notice.
privacy.s8: Questions about this policy? Reach out at
